name: feature.accessibility.nodes
description: Accessibility node pack (ADR 0363) — check authored content for WCAG issues (missing image alt text, skipped heading levels, non-descriptive link text, low color contrast) and propose AI alt text for one media asset (a proposal; nothing is written), both over ctx.features.accessibility.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Accessibility: Check Content
nodes.description: Runs the shared content-accessibility rules over an inline normalized model via ctx.features.accessibility.checkContent. Inputs: { images?, headings?, links?, colorPairs? }. Output: { issues: [{ kind, severity, wcag, nodeRef? }], count }.

nodes.label: Accessibility: Generate Alt Text
nodes.description: Proposes AI alt text for an image media asset via ctx.features.accessibility.generateAltText (composes the ADR 0108 vision seam; the run's person needs workspace:write in the org; media enforces IDOR + provider-absence). Nothing is written to the asset. Inputs: { orgId, assetId }. Output: { assetId, altText } (empty altText = decorative). Side-effectful: a paid vision call, so a replay fork serves the recorded proposal (ADR 1100 D6).
